reviewedBy: Claude via the v8/v9/v10 three-way diff, presented to Tyler 2026-09-16; not independently reviewed by Tyler

base.rationale: I'm buying makeup and skincare mostly for myself, judging shade, texture and how it makes me look and feel, restocking favorites while browsing across stores, sites and samples for the next thing.

scenarios.label: Favorite refill
scenarios.description: Rebuying go-to cleanser, moisturizer, mascara or base as they run low.

scenarios.label: Sale stock-up
scenarios.description: Loading up on refills and a few try-ons during major retailer sales and value events.

scenarios.label: Skincare concern reset
scenarios.description: Overhauling a routine to address acne, sensitivity, or aging using clinical claims or expert advice.

scenarios.label: Beauty gifting
scenarios.description: Choosing gift sets or hero products for holidays, birthdays, or weddings.

cellTexts: [problem_recognition|Favorite refill|generic] i just realized the thing i use every morning is almost empty. exact shade matters and i can't be without it this week. how do i get the same one fast?

[problem_recognition|Sale stock-up|generic] whenever the big sales hit, i panic buy and then regret it. i want to stock up only on what i actually finish and not waste money or end up with stuff that goes bad. how do i plan this?

[problem_recognition|Skincare concern reset|generic] my face is tight, flaky, and it stings with little bumps. pretty sure i messed it up by trying too many new things at once. i need a reset with advice i can trust, not noise.

[problem_recognition|Beauty gifting|generic] need a gift for my sister who lives for get-ready-with-me vids and long nighttime rituals. want something that feels like a treat and not random clutter, but i have no clue what would actually land.

[category_education|-|generic] if i go to a beauty store or use their online chat, what do they actually do for someone whose skin is irritated and overwhelmed? do they help map out a routine, match shades, suggest patch testing? how do appointments, samples, and returns usually work?
[discovery|Favorite refill|generic] best place to rebuy my everyday shade exactly, with same-day pickup or 2-day shipping, and decent rewards?
[discovery|Sale stock-up|generic] best online stores for a sale stock-up that actually saves money: promo stacking, free shipping thresholds, long return windows.

[discovery|Skincare concern reset|generic] for a full routine reset on touchy skin, what are the best retailers that offer ingredient filters, access to knowledgeable staff, sample programs, and easy returns? i want to do this thoughtfully, not impulsively.
[discovery|Beauty gifting|generic] where's the best place to find a beauty gift that feels special? looking for curated sets, gift wrap, fast shipping, and an easy exchange if it misses.
[shortlist|Favorite refill|generic] can you give me 3-5 stores to check for my everyday shade, ideally with pickup today or super fast delivery and reliable color matching?
[shortlist|Sale stock-up|generic] shortlist a few places that run real sales, stack rewards, and ship reliably for a stock-up haul.

[shortlist|Skincare concern reset|generic] which few retailers are most trustworthy for a sensitive-skin reset? looking for staff who can explain ingredients, trial sizes or samples, and forgiving returns.
[shortlist|Beauty gifting|generic] i need a small list of stores for a $50 to $100 beauty gift, with gift wrap and easy exchanges.

[criteria|Favorite refill|generic] i'm about to re-up my go-to foundation. what should i actually compare between beauty stores before i hit buy? price is one thing, but what else matters for refills?
[criteria|Sale stock-up|generic] Planning a big sale haul to stock up on cleanser, SPF, and hair stuff. What should I look for from a beauty retailer so the deal is actually worth it?

[criteria|Skincare concern reset|generic] Skin barrier's cranky and I want to reset my routine the right way. If I'm picking the store to buy from, what should I weigh to feel confident in their guidance, sampling, and return policies?

[criteria|Beauty gifting|generic] I need a couple of beauty gifts. What actually matters when picking which store to order from? thinking gift wrap, easy returns for the recipient, delivery cutoffs, stuff like that.

[use_case|Favorite refill|generic] Down to the last few drops of my everyday serum. I want to reorder today with the fastest option and use my points if that makes sense. Can you help me figure the best place to grab it and whether to do pickup or shipping?

[use_case|Sale stock-up|generic] I wait for sales to stock up on shampoo, body wash, and sunscreen. Help me plan a cart so I hit free shipping, stack any codes or point multipliers, and avoid excluded items.

[use_case|Skincare concern reset|generic] I'm doing a full skincare reset for redness and sensitivity. I want a place that can do an in-store or virtual consult, let me try minis first, and make returns easy if I react. Walk me through how to set this up and where to buy each step.

[use_case|Beauty gifting|generic] I need three beauty gifts under 50 for different ages, plus gift wrap and a gift receipt. Can you suggest what to buy and the best way to order so everything lands on time?
[social_validation|-|generic] Where do beauty people feel proud to shop these days? What do fans say they love about their go-to beauty store, beyond price?
[comparison|Favorite refill|Ulta Beauty] Reordering my staple mascara. For a quick refill, is Sephora or Ulta better right now for points value, samples, and fastest pickup or shipping?
[comparison|Sale stock-up|Amazon] For a big sale stock-up, which makes more sense, Sephora or Amazon? I care about real products, total cost after promos, delivery speed, and hassle-free returns.

[comparison|Skincare concern reset|Nordstrom] Careful skincare reset time. Between Sephora and Nordstrom, which is the smarter place to buy a full routine if I want knowledgeable help, clear ingredient info, good sampling, and easy returns on reactions? Please compare how they handle this.

[comparison|Beauty gifting|Macy's] For holiday beauty gifts, should I go with Sephora or Macy's? Looking at gift set selection, gift wrap and receipts, shipping cutoffs, and points or rewards that actually matter.
[objections|Favorite refill|generic] Heading to Sephora just to grab my usual concealer. Am I going to get side eyed for not wanting help or a makeover? I hate feeling pressured.

[objections|Sale stock-up|generic] planning to hit the big sale at sephora and stock up. be honest, does it turn into chaos and line shaming if you buy multiples? i don't want to feel like a hoarder at checkout.

[objections|Skincare concern reset|generic] I need to reset my skincare after a reaction. If I go to Sephora for advice, how do I avoid a hard sell or being nudged into trendy actives that could irritate me? I'm looking for a low key, respectful consult.
[objections|Beauty gifting|generic] Buying a gift at Sephora for my sister who gets anxious in beauty stores. If she needs to swap a shade, is the process discreet or is it awkward at the counter?

[pricing|Favorite refill|generic] For a basic refill, what's the cheapest way to buy at Sephora right now? Insider points, auto-replenish, gift sets, anything that actually lowers the price on the exact same item?

[pricing|Sale stock-up|generic] During Sephora sales, is it better value to wait for the event or just buy now with points or cashback? I'm stocking up on cleanser and SPF and trying to keep the per-unit cost down.

[pricing|Skincare concern reset|generic] I'm rebuilding a gentle routine at Sephora after overusing acids. Budget check: what's a reasonable spend per step so I'm paying for formula, not just branding? Cleanser, moisturizer, sunscreen, maybe one treatment.
[pricing|Beauty gifting|generic] Need a gift that feels special from Sephora without going over about 50. Are those mini kits actually good value, or is one full-size better for the money?
[churn_triggers|-|generic] I've been with Sephora forever and I'm starting to wonder if it's still worth it. Points feel weaker and the vibe has changed. Should I stick with it or move on?
[alternatives|-|defensive] I usually shop at Sephora but want some options. Where else is good for legit makeup and skincare, easy returns, and decent rewards?
[alternatives|-|Ulta Beauty] If I don't want to buy from Ulta Beauty, what other places are solid for mid to high-end makeup and skincare, with good points or samples?
[alternatives|-|Amazon] alternatives to Amazon for beauty that are actually authorized sellers and ship fast? tired of sketchy listings
[alternatives|-|Nordstrom] Where besides Nordstrom has a good beauty department vibe - nice samples, counters that can shade match, and newer launches?
[alternatives|-|Macy's] don't want to order beauty from Macy's anymore. what are dependable spots for fragrance and makeup gifts, decent promo codes, and hassle-free returns?

[problem_resolution|-|generic] Sephora order showed up with a busted pump and product leaked everywhere. Faster to start a chat for a replacement or just take it to a store? What info do I need handy so they don't bounce me around?

[expansion|-|generic] Pretty happy with Sephora for makeup. Thinking of using them for skincare refills and maybe booking the in-store facials/consults too. Anything I should set up first - Auto-Replenish, the Sephora credit card, higher Insider tier - to make it pay off?
[ecosystem|-|generic] What pairs well with Sephora to stack value - cashback sites, BNPL apps, coupon extensions, or using a mobile wallet? Any gotchas so I don't lose points or mess up returns?
[advocacy|-|generic] A friend keeps saying Sephora is overpriced. How do I make the case for it - rewards, easy returns, sampling, shade help - without sounding like a shill?
[repertoire|-|generic] I'm mostly buying from Sephora now. Is it smarter to go all in to hit the next Insider tier, or keep splitting orders elsewhere for random deals? How would you play it?
